comment: Tuesday bake-off matrix. Values starting with 'env:' are resolved from the environment by render-matrix.py at run time (BLOB_TOKEN is never written to disk). blobPathPrefix is assigned per run by render-matrix.py as bakeoff/<runId>/<case>. Seeds are pinned so a re-run is comparable. The finish-pass A/B is NOT a matrix case: finish_pass is pure ffmpeg, so it runs locally on the returned s2v-long clip for free.

cases.name: i2v-control-fast
cases.comment: Cheap regression control on the live lane, runs FIRST: proves the pod setup (models, extra_model_paths, ffmpeg, Blob) matches what the deployed endpoint does, for a few cents.
